<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>I was thinkin’ we could make the <$cdef(27)>third floor a place where
we’d all come and eat!
<$voicel(2,3)>But...I don’t know anyone who can make that much food.

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,7)>Wait, really? There’s a <$cdef(27)>Greedent who’s a good cook in the
town with the volcano?
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Whoa! That’s gotta be one amazing <$cdef(27)>Greedent!

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,7)>Wait, really? There’s a <$cdef(27)>Greedent who’s a good cook in the
town with the volcano?
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Whoa! That’s gotta be one amazing <$cdef(27)>Greedent!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>In that case, think you could get this <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(216)> to join us
so
<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,8)>we
can
start
workin’
on
the
<$cdef(27)>third floor?

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,10)>Just gimme the word once we’ve got all the materials
ready and a crew of Pokémon to help!

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Third floor’s next on our rebuild list. Go check out that
<$cdef(27)>building kit, <$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>then get us the materials and Pokémon
we need!

<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,803)><$voicel(3,6)>Oh, if it isn’t <$cdef(27)>! Can I help you
with something?
<$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,666)><$voicel(3,7)>Hm? You want me to cook for a restaurant in a big
building? <$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,5)>You really have been getting up to some pretty
impressive things out there, haven’t you, sweetie?

<$comeff(3,14)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,666)><$voicel(3,3)>You know, I never really intended to leave this town...
<$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,664)><$voicel(3,10)>But I could never refuse a request from you,
<$cdef(27)>,
dumpling!
So,
yes,
I’ll
go
to
that
building—for
a
while,
at least!
<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,8)>Just lead me to the building site!

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>Hey there, you made it! Happy to add you to our crew.
You must be that <$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,8)><$cdef(27)>Greedent who’s real good at cookin’!

<$facial(2,1)><$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,6)>Oh, my, you flatter me! ...I AM incredibly good at
cooking, though!
<$comeff(3,3)><$facial(3,1)><$motion(3,664)><$voicel(3,7)>I heard our dear <$cdef(27)> was up to
something
interesting,
so
I
came
to help!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Now that’s the kinda gung-ho attitude I like to see!
Thanks again for comin’ here!
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>We’re gonna need your help once we start workin’ on
the <$cdef(27)>third floor.

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Looks like we’ve got all the materials we need and a full
crew of eager Pokémon to help! Thanks for gettin’ all
this together, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Well, let’s get to it, then—time to start buildin’ the
<$cdef(27)>third floor!
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>It’ll take some time to finish, so come back later!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>The <$cdef(27)>third floor’s gonna need a bit more work. Come back
when we’re done!

You can check out the <$cdef(27)>building kit to see how much time is
left before construction is finished!

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,7)>The <$cdef(27)>third floor’s become a pretty nice restaurant, thanks
to <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(216)>!

<$facial(2,1)><$comeff(3,10)><$facial(3,4)><$motion(3,661)><$voicel(3,9)>Oh, but you mustn’t undersell yourself either, sweetie pie!
You led this project so well, I can really tell why they call
you <$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>Heh heh, thanks! Now then, one last floor to go... The
<$cdef(27)>fourth floor!

<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,48)>That sure sounds like an ambitious idea, rebuilding a big
building like that! <$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,664)><$voicel(3,10)>Let’s hurry to the construction site!
